title: Biomimetic design for zinc-based energy storage devices: principles, challenges and opportunities
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,8071-8135
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00093A, Review Article
Jian Song, Qian Zhang, Guangjie Yang, Kai Qi, Xue Li, Zhenlu Liu, Haoqi Yang, Ho Seok Park, Shaohua Jiang, Jingquan Han, Shuijian He, Bao Yu Xia
An overview summarizes the research status and progress of biomimetic design for zinc-based energy storage devices, analyzes the challenges and proposes future prospects in this field.
